title: Oil & Gas
summary: Oil and gas companies use PI System across upstream (wells, platforms, artificial lift), midstream (pipelines, compression, storage) and downstream refining. Large operators replace tag-based "spider web" architectures with a PI AF asset model, and phase enterprise rollouts asset by asset.
hierarchy:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  E[Enterprise] --> R[Region or Basin]
  R --> F[Field or Asset such as platform, FPSO or pad]
  F --> W[Facility or Well]
  W --> Q1[ESP]
  W --> Q2[Compressor]
  W --> Q3[Separator]
  E --> P[Pipeline System]
  P --> S[Segment]
  S --> ST[Compressor, Pump or Meter Station]
  E --> PL[Refinery Plant]
  PL --> U[Unit or System]
  U --> EQ[Equipment such as columns and control loops]
```

tags.name: Oil Rate
tags.description: Oil production rate on each well element, rolled up to field level.

tags.name: Temperature
tags.description: Equipment metal or process temperature, an input to the HTHA template.

tags.name: H2 Partial Pressure
tags.description: Hydrogen partial pressure, an input to the HTHA template.

tags.name: Exposure Hours
tags.description: Hours of exposure, calculated by an analysis for the HTHA template.

templates.name: HTHA Equipment
templates.description: Refinery equipment at risk of High Temperature Hydrogen Attack. Built from the inputs named in an OSIsoft deck; the attribute layout is illustrative.

templates.name: Well
templates.description: Upstream well element carrying production attributes that roll up to the field.

calculations.name: Field oil rate rollup
calculations.expression: Sum of Oil Rate (bbl/d) across child well elements
calculations.description: Rolls well production up to the field element. The rollup design is illustrative.

calculations.name: HTHA exposure
calculations.expression: Accumulate Exposure Hours while Temperature and H2 Partial Pressure exceed the limit curve
calculations.description: Feeds the HTHA event frame and notification. The expression shape is illustrative; the source names the inputs only.

eventFrames.name: HTHA limit exceedance
eventFrames.trigger: Temperature and hydrogen partial pressure exceed the limit curve for the equipment metallurgy

kpis.name: Cost per BOED
kpis.definition: Exploration and production cost per barrel of oil equivalent per day. OSIsoft cites a 2-5% year-on-year reduction as a benchmark target.

kpis.name: Controllable margin
kpis.definition: Margin attributable to operational decisions. OSIsoft cites a 1-5% year-on-year improvement target for hydrocarbon processing.

kpis.name: HC loss
kpis.definition: Hydrocarbon loss: unaccounted material found by material balancing.

kpis.name: Lifting cost
kpis.definition: The cost of producing oil from the well, named as an upstream KPI in the OSIsoft deck.

kpis.name: Plan vs Actual (PvA)
kpis.definition: Comparison of planned and actual production or yield, used with yield accounting.

regulation.name: 49 CFR 192 (PHMSA)
regulation.summary: US gas pipeline safety rules. PG&E used PI AF for alarm management and condition-based monitoring after a mandate to implement NTSB and PHMSA 49 CFR 192 following the 2010 gas explosion.

regulation.name: API RP 1165
regulation.summary: Pipeline SCADA display guidance. Enbridge describes its HMIs as API RP 1165-compliant with abnormal situation management support.

pitfalls: Tag-based "spider web" architectures make integration hard: one operator had 3+M tags with inconsistent naming across 29 historians. The remedy cited is an AF asset data object model.
Offshore data transmission brings security, performance and reliability issues; PI-to-PI is used for data quality and security.
Enterprise agreements need champions, defined business use cases and proven ROI before the rollout scales (Noble Energy).
Keep figures from different sources separate: MOL's "$500M-550M" EBITDA (2015 deck) and "$1 billion in EBITA since 2010" (2023 overview) are different claims.
verifyNote: The AF hierarchy, the HTHA template attribute layout and the well rollup are syntheses inferred from customer decks; no published AVEVA reference template library for oil and gas was found.
